utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Ira — are we still on for the repair drive this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, I’m still on for this afternoon. I’ll swing by after I finish my errands.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — what time should I expect you?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand with tools for the repair drive. What do you need?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks Gus — I’m still figuring that out, honestly. Maybe I’ll check what tools we’re short on and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — just let me know what’s missing, and I’ll see what I can spare.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is shaping up nicely—people are really pitching in. If you want, I can keep an ear out for any updates.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess—that’d help. I’m just a little worried about the logistics, so any updates would be great.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know as soon as I hear anything. Hopefully the logistics come together smoothly!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — could you help me keep track of the pickup locations and make sure the drop-off list stays updated?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can keep track of the pickup locations and update the drop-off list as we go. Just send me any changes, and I’ll stay on it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive’s coming up soon—have you heard about it yet? I’m happy to pass along the details and invite anyone else who might want to help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ve heard a little, thanks. If you’ve got the details, I’d appreciate you sharing them with me.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send you the details right away, and if you think of anyone else who’d want to help, I’m happy to invite them too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Leo — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep everyone in the loop. Tell me what you need from me first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa. Just send me the list of repairs and where to drop off any parts.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: You got it — I’ll send over the repair list and the part drop-off spot shortly. If anything changes, I’ll keep you posted.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks for checking in — what details do you need me to confirm about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Just the time and where you want me to show up — I usually end up joining a bit late.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: No worries — let’s say 6:30 at the community garage on Maple Street. If you’re running late, just text me when you’re on your way.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help line things up around school pickup if that makes the repair drive easier.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be a huge help, Faye — thank you. I’ll line up the repair drive around school pickup and keep you posted on the details.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thank you, Mara. Just send me the timing when you have it, and I’ll work my pickup schedule around it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive got a pretty good turnout. Did you see if they still need volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, they still need a few people for cleanup and sorting donations. I can check the sign-up sheet if you want.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, thanks. If there’s room, I can help with cleanup or sorting.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re still coming by with the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’m still coming by with it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely. If you need a hand, I can stop by and help for a bit.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’d be real kind of you, Rey. I’m still a bit all over the place with it, so any help would be much appreciated.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can swing by and help sort things out. Just tell me what you want me to start with.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure folks know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an eye on the supply list and make sure we’ve got what people need.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep telling folks the plan and send them your way if they ask about supplies.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any updates yet, but I can ask around while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira. I’d appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m heading out now, so I’ll ask around and let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right—the repair drive. I was meaning to ask if there’s anything you want me to bring or fix.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, actually—if you’ve got them, bring a screwdriver set and some duct tape. I’m planning to sort the loose shelf and a wobbly chair first.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing—I’ll bring a screwdriver set and some duct tape. And I’ll keep an eye out for that wobbly chair too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: If you can, bring the drill and a couple of screwdrivers over today. I’ll handle the rest and we’ll sort it out fast.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, I can bring those over today. I’ll grab the drill and a couple screwdrivers and head your way.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — if you need any tools for the repair drive, just let me know and I can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus — I’ll keep it in mind and let you know what I need. For now, I’m just sticking to the plan and taking it one step at a time.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Eli — just give me a shout when you’re ready, and I’ll bring whatever you need.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Quinn — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to take on?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s wonderful, Mara — could you help spread the word and make a quick signup list? I’ll send you the details right away.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, Quinn — I can do that. Send me the details and I’ll start the signup list and share the word.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Opal, I’m glad we’re doing the repair drive — it’s a nice way to get everyone together and help out. What do you need from me first?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — first I need the pickup locations and a quick count of what each one needs. Then I can map the route for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll gather the pickup locations and a quick count of what each one needs, then send it over so you can map the route.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll help keep the repair drive organized and make sure folks know where to bring their items. If you want, I can also draft a quick notice for the block.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That would be great, Rosa—please draft the notice. I’ll make sure we’ve got the supplies sorted and ready for drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course — I’ll draft a short notice and keep it clear about the drop-off time and what we’re collecting. Thanks, Cleo; I’ll send it over shortly.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve just been hearing bits and pieces about the repair drive—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s moving along, but we still need a few more hands and supplies. Have you heard if anyone’s already signed up to help?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard a little second-hand, but I can check around and see who’s signed up. If you know what supplies are still needed, I can pass that along too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m in—just give me the quick version of what’s needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — we just need a few volunteers, some tools, and a quick hand sorting donations. I can send you the details and time slots if you want.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, send me the time slots and I’ll grab one that fits. Keep it short and I’m in.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What still needs to be done?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re still in for helping with it?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I’m still in — happy to help with the repair drive.
